name: Springs
summary: Coil, torsion, extension and leaf springs, from pen springs to garage door springs.
uses: Spring steel for scrapers and tools
identify: Everywhere: mattresses, trampolines, recliners, screen doors, garage doors, vehicle suspension, cribs and toys. Garage door torsion springs sit on a bar above the door.
test: Look for cracks and rust pits; a good spring returns to its exact length. Never release a garage door torsion spring or a vehicle coil spring without the right tools and training.

decay.note: Lasts; rust pits can make springs snap.
